selection_rule: Choose the variant with larger mean selected-checkpoint validation AP across screen seeds 42 and 43; exact tie retains legacy_input_norm. No test evaluation during screening.
final_rule: Freeze the chosen input-normalization mode; reuse its two screen runs and train seeds 44-46 for v0. Train auxiliary v1 with seeds 42-46 and the same shared transformer settings. Test evaluation occurs only after all configurations are frozen; every seed is reported.
changed_factors: bypass initial LayerNorm(3) in normalization screen
11-feature auxiliary branch in final v0/v1 comparison
held_fixed: Original transformer optimizer, LR schedule, batch size 192, 80-epoch cap, patience 12, token dropout, shared dropout, cloned encoder initialization, architecture widths/depths. Effective attention dropout stays 0.15 in every run; the historical attention_dropout=0.10 argument remains recorded-only.
model_selection: Maximum validation AP selects checkpoint; validation F1 selects threshold.
limitations: Previously consulted fixed Kepler split; no untouched-test or TESS claim
Normalization screening uses two seeds; final metadata comparison uses five
Auxiliary extension changes inputs and parameter count; it does not isolate individual feature contributions
